hero.title: Satu Halaman untuk Semua Materi UTS
hero.text: Ulasan parts of speech, to be, present simple (semua subjek), adverbs of frequency, can/can't, articles, countable/uncountable, some/any, how much/many, serta ungkapan real life. Tab Kuis berisi 144 soal latihan gabungan (bukan soal ujian asli). Jadwal tutorial UTS: 14 November 2026.

cheatsheet.heading: Strategi UTS
cheatsheet.html: Sebagian besar soal grammar bisa dijawab dengan empat pertanyaan: (1) Subjeknya I, he/she/it, atau you/we/they? (2) Ada kata kerja? Tidak → be; ada → do/does; ada can → can + V1. (3) Kalimat apa? + / − / ?. (4) Noun-nya countable atau uncountable? (menentukan a/an, is/are, much/many).

modes.title: -s he/she

modes.text: money, water, homework → much; any di negatif dan pertanyaan, some untuk tawaran.

quiz.q: [P1] Reflexive pronoun yang benar untuk we adalah…
[P1] She ate an apple. Kata kerja ate termasuk…
[P1] They are trying to finish their projects. Kata are berfungsi sebagai…
[P1] Which book do you want? Kata which adalah…

quiz.exp: here = place, quickly = manner, yesterday = time.

quiz.q: [P1] in the morning dalam kalimat berfungsi sebagai…
quiz.exp: Contoh dosen: morning = noun, in the morning = adverb.

quiz.q: [P1] Preposition yang tepat: I was born ___ 2005.
[P1] Preposition yang tepat: The class starts ___ Monday.
[P1] To, into, towards, along adalah preposition of…

quiz.exp: For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So.

quiz.q: [P1] I stayed at home because it was raining. Kata because adalah…
[P1] Pasangan correlative conjunction yang benar adalah…

Mother provides her children for the best education.

quiz.q: [P1] Terjemahan yang benar untuk “Saya sedang makan” adalah…
[P2] Bentuk singkat dari he is not adalah…
[P2] Jawaban singkat yang benar untuk “Are you married?” adalah…
quiz.exp: Negatif boleh disingkat: I'm not. Positif: Yes, I am.

quiz.q: [P2] Urutan yang benar: from / is / Britain / your teacher ?
[P2] Respon yang tepat untuk “Nice to meet you.”
[P2] Kalimat yang penulisan huruf kapitalnya benar…

ringkasan:
*RANGKUMAN UTS BAHASA INGGRIS (P1–P7)*
1️⃣ Parts of speech: noun, pronoun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, conjunction.
2️⃣ be: am/is/are • Yes, I am / No, I'm not • a/an + pekerjaan.
3️⃣ Present simple: I/you/we/they + V1, don't, Do…? • he/she/it + V-s, doesn't, Does…? (NOT does she likes)
4️⃣ like/love/hate + -ing • always > usually > often > sometimes > never.
5️⃣ can/can't + V1 • a/an, the (the USA, the city centre), tanpa article (by bus, go home).
6️⃣ Countable vs uncountable • There's/There are • some (+) any (−/?) • How many / How much.
7️⃣ Jam: past/to • at night, on Sunday, in the morning.
🗓️ Tutorial UTS: 14 November 2026.

parts.label: Inti
parts.title: Subjek + kata kerja + keterangan
parts.text: Setiap kalimat butuh subjek dan kata kerja (atau be). Semua topik UTS adalah variasi pola ini.

parts.label: P1
parts.title: Parts of speech
parts.text: Kenali fungsi kata: noun, pronoun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, conjunction.

parts.label: P2
parts.title: to be
parts.text: am/is/are untuk nama, asal, umur, pekerjaan, status. Yes, I am / No, I'm not.

parts.label: P3 & P5
parts.title: Present simple
parts.text: I/you/we/they + V1 (don't, Do…?). he/she/it + V-s (doesn't, Does…?). + like -ing dan adverbs of frequency.

parts.label: P6
parts.title: can / can't
parts.text: Semua subjek: can + V1. Can she…? Yes, she can. / It depends.

parts.label: P2 & P6
parts.title: Articles
parts.text: a/an: pertama/pekerjaan; the: sudah jelas/satu-satunya; zero: kota, negara biasa, hari, by bus, go home.

parts.label: P7
parts.title: Countable / uncountable
parts.text: There's/There are, some/any, How much/How many.

materi.heading: Kesalahan yang paling sering dinilai salah
materi.html:
• Lupa be: She from Italy → She's from Italy.
  • Lupa a/an: I'm student → I'm a student.
  • Lupa -s: He like football → He likes football.
  • -s ganda: Does she likes → Does she like.
  • be + do bercampur: Are you like… → Do you like….
  • can + to: I can to swim → I can swim.
  • much/many: much friends → many friends.
  • Jam: half past nine = 09.30.
